lede.zh: 兩邊卷都用得着——只換例子同措施。順序跟作文框架：Opening → Problem analysis → Option comparison → Recommendation → Closing。
lede.en: Reusable on both papers — swap examples and measures only. Ordered by essay stages: Opening → Problem analysis → Option comparison → Recommendation → Closing.

items.zh: 本人贊成……的政策目標，惟反對一刀切……，宜先……。
items.en: I support the aim of …, but oppose a one-size-fits-all approach; we should first….
In the short term… but in the long term…
After weighing the pros and cons…

items.zh: 權衡取捨後，宜採用混合方案……
items.en: After weighing the trade-offs, a mix of … is preferred.

items.zh: 反對者或指……會增加成本／行政負擔；惟若不處理……，長遠代價更高，故仍宜……。
items.en: Critics may say … raises costs/admin burden; yet leaving … unaddressed costs more in the long run, so we should still….

items.zh: 若不採納原建議，仍宜以……作為替代，繼續推進……目標。
items.en: If the original proposal is not adopted, … remains a workable alternative to advance….
It is recommended that a pilot be launched…

items.zh: 應由〔政策局／部門〕主導，並由……支援。
items.en: The [bureau/department] should lead, with support from….

items.zh: 應設定指標以量度成效。
items.en: KPIs should be set to measure effectiveness.

items.zh: 在長遠方案出台前，需有過渡措施。
items.en: A stopgap measure is needed pending a longer-term solution.

items.zh: 可視乎檢討結果考慮擴大推行。
items.en: Consideration may be given to scaling up subject to review findings.
This helps to… but must be accompanied by…

items.zh: 仍有剩餘風險，應持續監察。
items.en: Residual risks remain and should be monitored.

items.zh: 綜上，本人維持……立場；落實時以……為優先，並持續檢討成效。
items.en: In sum, I maintain …; in delivery, prioritise … and keep reviewing outcomes.
